files.rationale: Kept PR A's instance-based Deduplicator (initialize(articles)/call, attr_reader, guid-first fingerprint with id+URL composite fallback that its specs and Html2rss.collect_articles rely on) and folded in PR B's normalize helper so guid/id/URL/title keys are stripped and blank values ignored, with the id preferred ahead of the URL and a normalized title fallback before the object hash.
